test_hermes_hooks_list: test the hermes hooks list command to display configured hooks and their allowlist status
test_hermes_hooks_test: test the hermes hooks test command to fire a hook script with a synthetic payload and verify JSON output
test_hermes_hooks_revoke: test the hermes hooks revoke command to remove an allowlisted hook entry by command path
test_hermes_hooks_doctor: test the hermes hooks doctor command to flag missing exec bits, unallowlisted scripts, and invalid JSON
test_hermes_hooks_doctor_safe: test that hermes hooks doctor skips unallowlisted scripts instead of executing them during the JSON smoke test
